name: clembench
description: clembench is a dialogue game-based evaluation framework for large language models that combines control over multi-turn, reference-free, repeatable interactions with goal-directedness. It provides a set of benchmark game instances in English and supports easy extension with new targeted tests, aiming to complement existing evaluation paradigms.
reputation: Clembench is a well-known and widely cited benchmark framework in the LLM evaluation community for interactive, goal-directed dialogue tasks.
notes: Focuses on goal-directed dialogue game evaluation; optimized for ease of use and extensibility.
